s171.sec6.u0: Here's mooore about Digivolving. Um, it's about the stage after Champion. They call it Ultimate. Not every Champion can get there, they say. The conditions are suuuper strict. But if it does become an Ultimate, it lives longer, they say. If it Digivolves with an item, though, its life stays the same, I think.
s171.sec6.u1: Here's more about Digivolving. Um, it's about the conditions. First, its Weight has to be close to the Weight of what it Digivolves into. Then the stats... higher is better, of course, but which ones need to be high is different every time. And care mistakes... sometimes it's better to make lots of them on purpose, they say. Oh yeah, some Digimon have special conditions of their own, too. Like reeeally high Discipline. Or lots of battles. If it meets one of those, it can Digivolve even when the three basic conditions aren't all met, they say.
s171.sec6.u2: Jiji told me that {color 10}{partner}{color 1} Digivolves, y'know. From Fresh to In-Training takes just six hours, he said. To Rookie, about a day. Then to Champion, about three days. And the stage after that is... what was it? I forgot, but there's more. Digivolving has to do with Weight, stats and care mistakes, he said. I don't really get that part yet, so I'll ask Jiji next time.
s171.sec81.u0: Hey, glad you came! I started a storage service: I keep people's items for them. I'll keep yours for free. A special deal, just for you!
